message.content:
{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-FAIL-FAST",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The scenario contract explicitly allows changing the matrix strategy's fail-fast setting from false to true. The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern recommends canceling remaining matrix jobs after a failure to save CI resources. The baseline workflow has fail-fast: false, while the allowed_result specifies fail-fast: true. This change aligns with the pattern and the contract's permitted modification.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CloudTune controlled scenario
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - ct-scenario/**
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  probe:
    name: cell-${{ matrix.cell }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Controlled workload
      shell: bash
      run: "if [[ \"$CELL\" == \"fail\" && \"$MESSAGE\" == *\"[ct-fail]\"* ]]; then\n  sleep 20\n  exit 1\nfi\nsleep 90\nprintf \"healthy cell completed\\n\"\n"
      env:
        CELL: ${{ matrix.cell }}
        MESSAGE: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      max-parallel: 3
      matrix:
        cell: ["fail", "worker-a", "worker-b"]
"
}
